title: Signature OpenAI Daybreak / Codex Security Stack: What AI-Assisted Defense Is: The Tiring Work, Automated
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigWard stack, Manon's original defensive-AI design. SigWard mirrors the scan-validate-remediate loop but every AI-proposed change requires human approval — the AI drafts, the human merges. The Signature design makes autonomous remediation structurally impossible: the AI has no write access to production, by architecture.
